effects.rationale: National education standards imply some level of government intervention in the educational system.
Supporting national education standards suggests a preference for public governance over market choice in education.

evidence_quote: "I support the idea of national education standards to ensure that all students across the country receive an equal and high-quality education." - [Source: Candidate's Statement on Education Issues, Year: 2010]
review_reason: The policy is described as supporting national education standards which implies a level of government intervention in educational governance.
